purpose: Define the minimum governed product signals needed to measure demonstrated SongChart product outcomes without turning telemetry into canonical music-domain truth or privileged audit.

search.performed.producer: app/Http/Controllers/Search/SearchController.php after BuildSearchPage returns a valid non-empty first-page result
search.performed.purpose: Measure actual first-page search volume and provide the denominator for zero-result rate.
search.performed.retention: indefinite_anonymous_aggregate_only; any new dimension reopens privacy_and_retention_review
search.performed.guardrail: pagination is excluded so page navigation does not inflate search demand

search.zero_result.producer: app/Http/Controllers/Search/SearchController.php when BuildSearchPage returns zero selected-filter results for a valid non-empty first-page query
search.zero_result.purpose: Measure the share of searches that return no results without retaining the query or actor.
search.zero_result.retention: indefinite_anonymous_aggregate_only; query-level demand evidence is deferred to Stage 28 or another explicit privacy-governed authority
search.zero_result.guardrail: aggregate evidence may guide later product work but cannot identify unmet queries or mutate canonical data

entity.viewed.purpose: Potentially measure public entity exposure, but no accepted downstream metric/action currently requires persistence.

persistence.degradation: telemetry write failure is reported but must not fail public search

future_expansion_gate.rule: Stage 27.0A aggregate approval does not authorize raw-event or user-level tracking.

stage_27_0a_scope.rule: No deferred event becomes active without a demonstrated producer, measurable consumer and updated privacy/retention authority.
